arabic text: KERBAL KI KAHAANI JAB, KOI BHI SUNAYE GA\nDIL WALO KE ANKHO SE EK DARYA BAHAAYE GA
english translation text: WHENEVER SOMEONE RECITED THE STORY OF KARBALA\nTHOSE WITH A HEART WEEP UNCONTROLLABLY

arabic text: WO QAFELA SARWAR KA, JO SHAAN SE NIKLA THA\nSUGHRA KO KHABAR KYA THI, NA LOT KE AAYE GA.\nZEHRA ZEHRA PURSA LO BAHATER KA
english translation text: HUSSAIN'S CARAVAN SEEMED MAGNIFICENT WHEN IT LEFT\nSUGHRA DIDN'T KNOW, IT WAS NEVER COMING BACK\nZAHRA ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR THE 72

arabic text: PAAMAL HUWA KAASIM, JAB GHORO KI TAAPO SE\nKIS TARHA CHACHA TERI, MAYYAT KO UTHAYE GA.\nZEHRA ZEHRA QASIM KA BHI PURSA LO
english translation text: QASIM WAS TRAMPLED BY THE HOOFS OF HORSES\nHOW WILL HE GIVE A FUNERAL TO HUSSAIN?\nZAHRA ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR QASIM

arabic text: THA HATHO KE KATNE KA, KUCH GHAM NA DILAWAR KO\nSAYDANIYO KA PARDA, AB KON BACHAYE GA\nZEHRA ZEHRA ABBAS KA PURSA LO
english translation text: HUSSAIN HAD NO SORROW OVER SACRIFICING HIS ARMS\nHE WAS DISTRAUGHT OVER WHO WILL PROTECT THE LADIES' HIJABS\nZAHRA ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR ABBAS

arabic text:
TOOTI HAI QAMAR SHEH KI,
GHABRANA MAGER AKBER
FARZANDE NABI TERI, MAYYAT KO UTHAYE GA.
ZEHRA ZEHRA AKBER KA BHI PURSA LO
english translation text:
HUSSAIN'S BACK IS BROKEN BUT DON'T
BE ALARMED AKBAR THE SON OF
THE PROPHET WILL RETRIEVE YOUR BODY
ZAHRA ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR AKBAR TOO

arabic text:
SOTE HEE NA THAY ASGHAR, JUHLAY ME TARAPTE THAY
MADER KO KHABER KYA THI,
ZEHRA ZEHRA ASGHAR KA BHI PURSA LO
EK TEER SULAAYE GA.
english translation text:
ASGHAR COULDN'T SLEEP, HE WAS TREMBLING IN
HIS COT WHAT DID HIS MOTHER KNOW
THAT AN ARROW WOULD MAKE HIM
STOP ZAHRA ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR ASGHAR

arabic text:
SARWAR NE UTHAE THAY,
SAB SAATHIYO KE LAASHE
SHABBIR TERA LAASHA, AB KON UTHAYEN GA
ZEHRA ZEHRA SHABBIR KA PURSA LO
english translation text:
HUSSAIN RETRIEVED THE BODIES OF
ALL HIS SUPPORTERS WHO WILL
RETRIEVE HUSSAIN'S BODY? ZAHRA
ACCEPT OUR CONDOLENCES FOR HUSSAIN
